italian-reading-4.title: Hard G
italian-reading-4.subtitle: Read ga, go, and gu
italian-reading-4.description: Hear the hard G sound in ga, go, gu and find it in familiar words.

ir4-p1.translations: The cat looks at a rose.

ir4-t1.text: In ga, go, gu, G has a hard sound: gatto, gomma, gusto.

ir4-t2.text: This rule does not cover every word with G: its sound changes before E and I.

ir4_q1.question: In which syllables does G have the hard sound taught in this lesson?

ir4_q2.question: Which word contains the combination ga?

ir4_q3.question: Which word contains hard G before A?

ir4_q4.question: Which word contains hard G before U?
